description: Kolada, the Swedish municipal and regional KPI database run by RKA — list the organizational units it tracks (schools, preschools, eldercare facilities) within one of Sweden's 290 municipalities or 21 regions. Returns id, title, municipality. OU ids can be used for unit-level data drilldowns. Filter by title substring and/or municipality id.

municipalityId.description: Restrict to a municipality/region id, e.g. "0180".

title.description: Substring of the unit name (Swedish), e.g. "skola" or "förskola".

name: list_org_units
title: List Org Units
